name: musiccode-studio
description: Crie músicas usando programação (JavaScript, HTML e em breve Lua/Python/Java). Web Audio API + Capacitor.

scripts.test: mkdir -p scripts/out && node node_modules/esbuild/bin/esbuild scripts/test-theory.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --outfile=scripts/out/theory.mjs && node node_modules/esbuild/bin/esbuild scripts/test-api.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --outfile=scripts/out/api.mjs && node scripts/out/theory.mjs && node scripts/out/api.mjs
scripts.cap:android: npm run build && cap add android && cap sync
scripts.cap:ios: npm run build && cap add ios && cap sync
